body: Aman does not know which storage layer holds the login in his apps, and guessing decides how much machinery gets built. Write a probe (bookmarklet or tiny unpacked extension) that, on a logged-in page, reports which of document.cookie / localStorage / sessionStorage / IndexedDB holds something token-shaped, then diffs against the logged-out state to confirm which entry is actually the credential. Run it on every app. PASS: a written table of app -> auth layer(s). This gates every other spike: if most apps turn out to be sessionStorage or bearer-token, the heavy engine is deferrable.
title: S0 — probe where each app keeps its auth
